north.title: The roots
north.text: Everything down here is made of blocks. Throw an intention at one and see what happens.

south.title: Doubt
south.subtitle: A projection
south.text: A pattern that blocks your way, given a body made of blocks. No projection lives in the roots.

north.title: Good and bad
north.text: Your intentions are good or bad. Good ones heal and make creatures grow; bad ones break blocks and hurt.

south.title: Move and jump
south.text: Press {jump} to jump one block, never two. Break some dirt, walk into it to pick it up, set it by the wall, climb.

north.title: Behind the wall
north.text: Every wall was once built to keep you safe. You can always break one, or build a better one.

south.title: Break through
south.text: A wall stands in your way. Make your intentions bad and break it: the dirt in the middle gives way first.

north.title: Mend
north.text: Good intentions close cracks. Crack a dirt block with bad ones, switch back, and mend it.

south.title: Mossling
south.subtitle: A creature of rest
south.text: Stay still beside it for three seconds and it rests with you: you heal a quarter of a heart.

north.title: A way out
north.text: Too wide to jump, too deep to climb. Carry a block, set it against the wall, step up, build your way out.

south.title: Wonder
south.subtitle: A creature of curiosity
south.text: A paper moth that keeps you company from a distance. It never touches you and never fights.

north.title: A bridge
north.text: Stand at the edge, place a block in front of you, step onto it, and do it again.

south.title: Rootling
south.subtitle: A creature of the roots
south.text: It potters along on two short legs, never too close to you and never too far away.

north.title: Keys and bombs
north.text: Keys open locks. Bombs burst, and can hurt you too. You count them; they take no hand.

south.title: Bombs
south.text: Obsidian is too hard for intentions. Break the dirt in the wall, or drop a bomb with bad intentions.

north.title: Kick and throw
north.text: With full hands, you kick the loose cubes you walk into. You can also throw one. Both hurt projections.

south.title: Crates
south.text: Break a crate with bad intentions. Now and then one holds a key, a heart or a bomb.

north.title: Fire and lava
north.text: Not in the roots. Deeper down, fire and lava burn. Water puts out fire and turns lava into stone.

south.title: Water
south.text: Wade through the shallows. In deep water, press {jump} to swim up.

north.title: The Sanctuary
north.text: The Boundary keeps this chest. Take the quick gift, or sit a short meditation for a better one.

south.title: Practices
south.text: A practice is a way of growing. Take one and it changes what you can do, and who you are.

north.title: Come back
north.text: The roots remember you. Walk through every room before you go, and next time the walls may say more.

south.title: The way down
south.text: The way down asks a price: one thing you carry. A key, a bomb, a block or a heart.

south.title: Potions
south.text: What released projections leave can become potions. With a flask on top of your hand, drink it.

south.title: The alembic
south.text: On floors 2, 4, 6 and 8. Feed it up to three parts or blocks, then touch it with a good intention.

north.title: The kitchen
north.text: On floors 1, 3, 5 and 7. Give it a part and it cooks you a meal. Three meals, then its fire is out.

south.title: Plain Tonic
south.subtitle: A potion
south.text: What the alembic makes when no recipe fits. Plain, but never nothing.

south.title: Restoring Draught
south.subtitle: A potion
south.text: A deep breath in a bottle, for when the hearts run low.

south.title: Spring Tonic
south.subtitle: A potion
south.text: Your legs remember how to leap. It lasts until the next floor.

north.title: Clear Infusion
north.subtitle: A potion
north.text: The mind clears: intentions fly farther and faster for three sealed rooms.

north.title: Questioning Tincture
north.subtitle: A potion
north.text: A question loosens a lock: the next locked door or chest asks one key less.

north.title: Hearty Meal
north.subtitle: A food
north.text: Cooked from a heart, mind or essence part. A flesh part makes a Small Meal instead.

north.title: Bosses
north.text: Every floor below ends with a boss. Overcome it and its practice appears, and the way down opens.

south.title: Projections
south.text: Bad intentions release a projection. Good ones warm it until it turns to your side.

north.title: Second-Guessing
north.subtitle: A projection · floors 3–7
north.text: It comes at you, stops short as if it were unsure, and then lunges.

south.title: Parts
south.text: A released projection may leave a part: flesh, heart, mind or essence. It rides in your hand.

north.title: Inner Critic
north.subtitle: A projection
north.text: It keeps its distance and lobs judgements at your head. A placed block stops them.
north.note: May leave a heart or a key.

south.title: The Margin
south.subtitle: A projection · floors 3–6
south.text: It never moves. It marks the ground where you stand, which slows you, and it shoots at you.

north.title: Alarm
north.subtitle: A projection · floors 3–6
north.text: Like Panic, it rushes at you, swells and bursts. It sets off every Alarm and Panic near it.
north.note: Water calms it for a moment.

south.title: Panic
south.subtitle: A projection
south.text: It rushes at you and swells before it bursts. Step out of reach while it swells.

north.title: Resistance
north.subtitle: A boss · floors 1–2
north.text: A door that walks. It comes at you and rams, and what it rams breaks.

south.title: Inertia
south.subtitle: A boss · floors 1–2
south.text: A ball of packed earth, asleep. A push wakes it; then it rolls and bounces off the walls.

north.title: The Insatiable
north.subtitle: A boss · floors 1–2
north.text: A giant stone cup that never walks. It pulls the room toward its mouth and spits it back.

south.title: Overwhelm
south.subtitle: A boss · floors 3–4
south.text: A tide with a face of foam. It surges at you, and its waves are low enough to jump.

north.title: The Downpour
north.subtitle: A boss · floors 3–4
north.text: A low ceiling of cloud. It rains on where you are going, and comes lower as it weakens.

south.title: The Hoard
south.subtitle: A boss · floors 3–4
south.text: A mound of all it kept. It rolls weights at you, pulls everything back to its pile, then bursts open.

north.title: The Verdict
north.subtitle: A boss · floor 6
north.text: A long bench with seven lecterns. It fires three accusations at once, then marks the floor to slow you.

south.title: The Threshold Guardian
south.subtitle: A boss · floor 5
south.text: A tall gate of stone. Bars of force cross the room where you stand; at the end it charges and lands on you.

north.title: The Old Rule
north.subtitle: A boss · floor 6
north.text: A tall stone tablet. In the circles it lays down you cannot cast, and near it you slow down.

south.title: The Grudge
south.subtitle: A boss · floor 6
south.text: A back of mud and two eyes. It sinks, and rises somewhere else in a ring that hurts.

north.title: The Impostor
north.subtitle: A boss · floors 7–8
north.text: A brass frame with a smile too wide. It calls up Doubt, the Critic and Panic to fight for it.

south.title: The Furnace
south.subtitle: A boss · floors 7–8
south.text: A great furnace with a mouth for a door. It draws you toward it, and then the floor catches fire.

north.title: The Shadow
north.subtitle: A boss · floor 9
north.text: It moves as you move. At the end it stops fighting: stand still beside it for three seconds.
north.note: Its way down asks no toll.

south.title: The Many Faces
south.subtitle: A boss · floors 7–8
south.text: A cube ringed with masks. It calls a projection to its side, then jumps from place to place.

north.title: Where practices wait
north.text: On pedestals in treasure rooms, in the chest a Boundary keeps, and where a boss was overcome.

south.title: Paths
south.text: Every practice follows a path: miracles, body, mind, emotion or will. Its mark tells you which.

north.title: Visualization
north.subtitle: A practice · mind
north.text: See it before you do it: intentions fly farther and faster. The Sanctuary keeps a sitting of it.

south.title: States of being
south.text: Hold three practices of one path, body, mind, emotion or will, and you reach a state of being.

north.title: Grounding
north.subtitle: A practice · body
north.text: Rooted in the body, you push with your whole weight. The Sanctuary keeps a sitting of it.

south.title: Second Brain
south.subtitle: A practice · mind
south.text: Let something else hold what you carry: you can carry one more block.

north.title: Kaizen
north.subtitle: A practice · will
north.text: Small, steady steps: your intentions go on through two soft blocks, dirt or crates.

south.title: Gratitude Journal
south.subtitle: A practice · emotion
south.text: Notice what is going well. The Sanctuary keeps a sitting of it.

north.title: Stoic Resolve
north.subtitle: A practice · will
north.text: Weighty, steady intentions: they hit harder, grow bigger and drop faster.

south.title: Box Breathing
south.subtitle: A practice · body
south.text: In for four, hold for four, out for four. The Sanctuary keeps a sitting of it.

north.title: Radical Acceptance
north.subtitle: A practice · emotion
north.text: Stop fighting what already happened: your own bombs and thrown blocks no longer hurt you.

south.title: Self-Compassion
south.subtitle: A practice · emotion
south.text: You speak to yourself the way you would to a friend. The Sanctuary keeps a sitting of it.

north.title: Recipes
north.text: The alembic reads all it holds. The most exact recipe wins; if none fits, you get a Plain Tonic.

south.title: Dr. Launcher
south.subtitle: A practice · miracles
south.text: Cast twice, quickly, and one of your bombs flies as a missile where you look, bursting on what it meets.

north.title: Restoring Draught
north.subtitle: A recipe
north.text: Two flesh parts, from any pattern.

south.title: Footing Tincture
south.subtitle: A recipe
south.text: One flesh part from a pattern of the body path, and a block of deepstone or obsidian.

north.title: Spring Tonic
north.subtitle: A recipe
north.text: One heart part, from a pattern of the body path.

south.title: Clear Infusion
south.subtitle: A recipe
south.text: Two mind parts, from two different patterns of the mind path.

north.title: Questioning Tincture
north.subtitle: A recipe
north.text: A mind part from Doubt or one of its forms, and a block of iron ore.

south.title: Six sittings
south.text: The Sanctuary keeps six meditations, each from a practice. Finish one and the chest gives you a greater practice.

north.title: Patient Draught
north.subtitle: A recipe
north.text: A heart part and a mind part, both from the same pattern of the will path.

south.title: Berserker Draught
south.subtitle: A recipe
south.text: Two heart parts from patterns of the will path, and a block of obsidian.

north.title: Above and below
north.text: Above the great tree, the sky has five floors, each with a guardian and a herd. Here they meet the creatures below.

south.title: Creatures
south.text: Creatures are not patterns, and they never die. Hurt one and it hides until its room is cleared.

north.title: The giant panda
north.subtitle: A guardian · sky floor 1
north.text: It floats over its bamboo seat. Stand still on a column top and it waits longer to act.

south.title: Chirper
south.subtitle: A creature · floors 1–2
south.text: A cellar cricket. It sings while its room is safe and falls silent when a projection is there.

north.title: Delver
north.subtitle: A creature · floors 1–3
north.text: A small digger with a cap of dirt, wandering as if it had a hole to get to.

south.title: Little pandas
south.subtitle: A herd · sky floor 1
south.text: They walk slowly, climb, roll down the slopes and sit. Nothing they do hurts you.

north.title: The koala
north.subtitle: A guardian · sky floor 2
north.text: Asleep until you come near. Get too close and it vanishes, to appear again far away.

south.title: Bubbler
south.subtitle: A creature · floors 3–4
south.text: A small fish of deep water. It never climbs out of its pool.

north.title: Koalas
north.subtitle: A herd · sky floor 2
north.text: They sleep in clusters and hang under branches. If one drops on you, jump three times.

south.title: Ferryback
south.subtitle: A creature · floors 3–4
south.text: The largest creature of all. It drifts slowly across deep water, broad and pale.

north.title: The elephant
north.subtitle: A guardian · sky floor 3
north.text: It remembers where you stood still the longest, and aims there. Keep moving.

south.title: Leafling
south.subtitle: A creature · floors 1–5
south.text: A little light shaped like a leaf. Bad intentions pass right through it.

north.title: Star-mite
north.subtitle: A creature · floors 1–5
north.text: A tiny mite with three points of light on its back, like a small constellation.

south.title: Young elephants
south.subtitle: A herd · sky floor 3
south.text: They walk in file round the waterhole, and shoulder aside anyone in their way.

north.title: Inkmite
north.subtitle: A creature · floors 5–6
north.text: A tiny mite, black as ink. Its two eyes are the only light on it.

south.title: The lion
south.subtitle: A guardian · sky floor 4
south.text: It basks on its ledge. Its roar sends out a ring that holds you still: jump as it passes.

north.title: Cinderwalker
north.subtitle: A creature · floors 7–8
north.text: It walks through fire and over lava, and nothing burns it.

south.title: The pride
south.subtitle: A herd · sky floor 4
south.text: Lions that stalk low and pounce from above. Watch one, and it stops to stare back.

north.title: Huddler
north.subtitle: A creature · floor 9
north.text: A small round creature with a rim of frost. Bad intentions pass right through it.

south.title: Drifter
south.subtitle: A creature · floors 5–6
south.text: A pale plate with a low dome on its back. It floats about two blocks above the floor.

north.title: The horse
north.subtitle: A guardian · sky floor 5
north.text: It leaps between paddocks. Stand still near it and it comes to you: then good hits count twice.
north.note: Won, it leaves the Triple Jump

south.title: Horses
south.subtitle: A herd · sky floor 5
south.text: They gallop a wide loop, and kick anyone standing behind them.

north.title: Warm a boss
north.text: Bosses can be warmed too. Fill one with good intentions until it turns to your side: that also overcomes it.

south.title: White bombs
south.text: Drop a bomb with good intentions: it bursts in light, mends blocks and turns lava into water.

north.title: Red heart
north.subtitle: A heart
north.text: It fills one heart of your containers. At full health it waits on the floor until you are hurt.

south.title: Hard hits
south.text: A thrown block hurts by its hardness. Dirt barely bruises; obsidian hits like two or three intentions.

north.title: Chests
north.text: A padlock's keyholes tell how many keys a chest asks. Brass trim means a practice waits inside.

south.title: The seal
south.text: Step into a room with projections and its doors slam shut until the last one is gone. The roots never seal.

north.title: Blue heart
north.subtitle: A heart
north.text: One more heart after your containers, even at full health. Once spent, it is gone for good.

south.title: Stone heart
south.subtitle: A heart
south.text: While it takes the blows, every hit you take is halved.

north.title: Black heart
north.subtitle: A heart
north.text: Like the blue heart: one more heart, lost for good once spent. Only far rarer.

south.title: Star heart
south.subtitle: A heart
south.text: One heart back, and thirty seconds when nothing can touch you.

north.title: Berserker heart
north.subtitle: A heart
north.text: While you hold it: stronger, faster, higher, but your intentions fall short. Shots bounce off you.

south.title: Blood heart
south.subtitle: A heart
south.text: You heal slowly, up to two hearts. A single hit stops it.

north.title: The toll
north.text: Each way down asks more: one thing more on every floor until the fifth, then practices.

south.title: Paying with hearts
south.text: A heart given to the toll is a payment, not a hit. It never kills you, and your last heart is never taken.

north.title: The Listener
north.subtitle: A presence · floors 1–5
north.text: Offer it the heart part of a released pattern, and it gives you something back.

south.title: Omens
south.text: Before a projection appears, cold motes gather where it will stand. While you stay that close, it waits.

north.title: Growing
north.text: Good intentions make a creature grow, up to three times its size. The first time, a grown one may leave a heart.

south.title: Cleared rooms
south.text: When the last projection of a room is gone, the room leaves a heart, a bomb or a key about half the time. Luck helps.

north.title: Not now
north.text: Close the Sanctuary and nothing is lost: the chest stays shut, and the Boundary asks again when you come back.

south.title: The Boundary
south.subtitle: A presence
south.text: A tall, calm column of limestone that keeps a chest. Walk up to it and its Sanctuary opens.

north.title: The hidden book
north.text: This is the last lesson. Walk every room once more, and next time the walls will speak in their own voice.

south.title: Mastery
south.text: Every achievement raises the mastery of the roots, up to 100. The higher it is, the more you find here when you wake.

You came down into the basement of your own mind. Down here, what you set your will on changes. Every wall was something you built to stay safe. Once it kept you safe. Now it keeps you small, and you are allowed to break it.

north.text: Authenticity is not changing what one is, and marking out what one has. It is the capacity to show oneself just as one is, without hiding. What is authentic is, and has worth. Authenticity is not trying to be better. That is a sense of duty, an obligation, an order, a façade. True authenticity is showing oneself, without judgement, without fear of being disqualified.
north.author: Guillermo Borja

south.text: The shapes that block your way are not people. They are patterns: a doubt, a judging voice, a fear at the edge of change. Each one wants something for you, in its own clumsy way. Warm them, and some will turn and walk beside you.

Above the roots, a great tree climbs into the sky. Below them, the floors go down, older and colder, to the silence. It is one journey, seen from both ends. What you learn at the bottom grows toward the light.

south.title: Move and jump
south.text: Press {jump} to jump one block, never two. The steps you built are still here; deeper down, build your own.

south.title: Broken through
south.text: This wall once stood in your way. You broke it, and the way stays open. Bad intentions break; good ones mend.

north.title: The way out
north.text: You built your way out of here once, and the roots kept your steps. Deeper down: carry a block, set it, step up.

north.title: Your bridge
north.text: Your bridge still stands. Deeper down, stand at the edge, place a block in front of you, step on, and again.

south.title: Bombs
south.text: The obsidian seal is gone. Deeper down, obsidian is too hard for intentions: drop a bomb with bad ones.
